title: HEALING
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: But for you who revere my name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its rays. And you will go out and frolic like well-fed calves.

session.prompt: Pray Malachi 4:2 back to God slowly — ask for the healing that rises with Him, and picture yourself free and full of life.

coaching_notes: Healing takes time. Especially emotional healing. Keep clinging to the hope that God is at work in you even when you don't see it.
